subtitle.what: What Aula did for you while you weren’t looking

why.summary: It’s your “Aula always on” summary: what you have today and what’s coming.
why.offer: An exam is coming up and you don’t have a course for it yet.
why.followup: Aula scheduled this follow-up during a conversation to let you know when there was news.

empty.title: Nothing pending
empty.body: When Aula does something for you (the morning summary, a reminder, what’s new on your platform), you’ll see it here.
empty.filteredBody: Try another filter or clear the search.
empty.snoozedBody: What you snooze comes back on its own, unread and at the top, when you choose.
empty.archivedBody: What you archive stays here in case you need it again.

detail.onlyHere: This message is only in your Inbox.

proactive.title: Aula always on
proactive.offer: Every morning it summarizes your day, reminds you before deadlines and exams and checks your platform, even with the window closed. On your platform it only reads.
proactive.lightHint: Reminders and exam-prep offers are free: they arrive while Aula is open, even with this mode off.
proactive.runsLeft_one: Enough left today for one more check.
proactive.runsLeft_other: Enough left today for about {{count}} more checks.
proactive.exhausted: Today’s budget is used up. Urgent items still come through from a reserve; the rest resumes tomorrow.
proactive.upNextEmpty: When you turn on “Aula always on”, this is where you’ll see what it will do and when.

automations.overviewTitle: Aula works for you while you’re away
automations.overviewBody: Ask it to watch your platform, remind you of dates or prepare a summary at the time you want. It only reads: it never submits, sends or changes anything, and whatever it finds waits for you in your Inbox.
examples: Check Canvas every day at 8:00 and tell me if there’s anything new
Check three times a day whether the new semester assignments are up and tell me when they appear
Remind me of every deadline 24 h and 2 h before
On Fridays at 18:00 tell me what I have pending for next week
automations.started: Running: the result will arrive in your Inbox.

editor.subtitle: Aula will do it on its own at the right time and leave the result in your Inbox.
editor.name: Name
editor.whatPlaceholder: Check my Canvas notifications and tell me if anything new arrived (assignments, announcements, grades).
editor.untilFound: When it finds it, tell me and stop looking
editor.safety: On your platform it only reads: it never submits, sends, starts exams or changes anything, and never signs in on its own.

settingsCard.hint: Summarizes your day, reminds you of deadlines and exams, checks your platform and prepares reviews, even with the window closed. On your platform it only reads: it never submits, starts exams, sends messages or changes anything.

styleDetail.quiet: Only urgent things make a sound. The rest waits in your Inbox.
styleDetail.balanced: Tells you about new and urgent things, without overdoing it.
styleDetail.attentive: Checks more often and tells you more.
styleDetail.custom: With the numbers you chose by hand.

settingsCard.quietHint: Aula schedules nothing, and anything not urgent waits until they end.
settingsCard.notificationsHint: Otherwise everything stays in your Inbox.
settingsCard.openAtLoginHint: When you close the window, Aula stays in the tray doing what’s scheduled.
settingsCard.followupsHint: “Tonight I’ll check whether the teacher posted the slides and tell you.” They use the same budget.
